subject: Exec approval: Hosted API >20% discount for HealthScale retention
messages:
From: Ari Grant <ari@healthscale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing ask — retention and expanded usage

Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the pilot guidance — HealthScale will move to production next month, but we have an urgent budget conversation with the board this week. Usage is ramping faster than expected: current run-rate looks like ~18M tokens/mo and projected growth to 45M tokens/mo in Q3.

Our procurement has asked whether Redwood can provide a one-time commercial concession of 25% off our Hosted API list rates for the first 12 months to commit to a 12-month purchase order. Without a concession like that, we risk delaying the rollout and potentially moving some processing in-house while we evaluate options.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a 25% discount on the Hosted API usage tier for the first year? If there are other structures (ramp credits, usage tiers) we can consider, we’re open, but the board needs a concrete number by Friday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Ari
Ari Grant
Director of Product Ops, HealthScale
ari@healthscale.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Grant <ari@healthscale.com>
Date: 2029-04-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing ask — retention and expanded usage

Team — forwarding HealthScale's ask (below). Quick summary and recommended path:

Summary:
- Customer: HealthScale (large payer-analytics customer)
- Current run-rate: ~18M tokens/mo; forecast ~45M tokens/mo within 3 months
- Ask: 25% off Hosted API list pricing for the first 12 months tied to a 12-month PO
- Risk: If denied, customer may delay or partially self-host; retention risk to a strategic account

My recommended concession (to propose to customer):
1) Approve a 25% off list Hosted API usage for 12 months (matches their ask), conditioned on a signed 12-month PO and minimum committed spend of $450,000 ARR equivalent.
2) Add a mid-term review at 6 months to evaluate unit economics and potential swap to tiered pricing thereafter.
3) Legal to review SOW; Finance to confirm credit terms. DocuSign link for SOW (draft attached).

Attachments: HealthScale_SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW), healthscale-usage-q1.csv (usage report)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-7821
DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/exec/HS-7821-sign

Requesting exec sign-off by EOD today so I can respond to Ari with a firm commercial offer.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Date: 2029-04-09T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask — retention and expanded usage

Ben — quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:
1) Confirmed gross margin at the proposed 25% off for expected Q3 volumes? Need a ballpark to validate the commercial precedent.
2) Would finance accept the $450k committed-spend construct or do they want a minimum monthly billing guarantee?
3) Are there any special support SLAs the customer will insist on (they mentioned production next month)? If so we should include a one-time onboarding/ops fee rather than expand the discount.

If margin holds and we get a commit (either $450k total or $37.5k/mo min), I’m inclined to approve — prefer a tiered fallback after month 6 rather than an open-ended discount. Legal loop in to ensure no unusual indemnities.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Enterprise
marissa@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-09T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing ask — retention and expanded usage

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the numbers with finance and ops. Decision: APPROVED with conditions.

Executive approval (Mina Haddad) granted: 25% discount on Hosted API usage for first 12 months subject to the following conditions being met and documented in the SOW/Order Form:
- Signed 12-month PO or DocuSign order committing to minimum $450,000 spend (arranged as either upfront or monthly invoices with credit checks).
- Inclusion of a 6-month review clause that allows Redwood to switch to tiered pricing if unit economics materially differ (>10% adverse variance).
- Customer pays a one-time onboarding & production support fee of $15,000 to cover escalations during rollout.
- Legal to remove any open-ended indemnity language in the attached SOW.

Ben — you have my sign-off to proceed and send the commercial offer to Ari with those conditions. Please copy me on the final order.

Mina Haddad
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

Ari / Maya,

- One-time onboarding & production support fee: $15,000
- 6-month commercial & usage review to confirm pricing cadence and possible move to a tiered rate thereafter
- Legal will remove the open-ended indemnity clause; SOW attached for signature.
